mBuff.mDescription:
Pix, Faerie CompanionPix fires a barrage of 3 bolts, dealing @f1@ magic damage total, at whomever Lulu attacks.

These bolts are homing but can be blocked by other units.Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Pix is a wild Faerie that accompanies Lulu. Pix will fire a barrage of magical energy at targets that Lulu attacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Pix will fire a barrage of 3 magical energy bolts at targets that Lulu attacks, dealing <magicDamage>@FairyDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> each.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended: Pix will fire a barrage of 3 magical energy bolts at targets that Lulu attacks, dealing <magicDamage>@FairyDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> each. These bolts are homing but can be blocked by other units.

mBuff.mDescription:
Pix's ''Assistance''Pix is following this unit, revealing this unit to his allies and being generally annoying.

Hey! Listen!Source: @SourceName@

<titleLeft>Pix's Assistance</titleLeft><mainText>Pix is following this unit and shielding it from incoming damage. When this unit attacks, Pix will aid this unit instead of Lulu.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Glittertrance</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's movement speed is heavily reduced but they will recover over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Lulu's Assistance</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's speed and ability power are increased.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Lulu's ''Assistance''This unit is pacified and cannot attack or cast spells.

This unit is also adorable.Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
On Ally Cast: Commands Pix to jump to an ally and then follow and aid their attacks instead of Lulu's for 6 seconds. Upon arrival, Pix shields for @TotalShield@ damage for 6 seconds.

On Enemy Cast: Pix deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to target enemy unit. Pix then follows and grants vision of them for 6 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that heavily slows all enemies it hits. An enemy can only be damaged by one bolt.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage, enemies hit are Slowed by @SlowAmount*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ second(s). This slow decays over time to a minimum of @MinMoveSpeedMod@% (Minimum is capped at 80%).

An enemy can only be damaged by one bolt.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Wild Growth</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's health is increased and they will periodically slow nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Lulu enlarges her ally, <status>Knocking Up</status> nearby enemies into the air. For @BuffDuration@ seconds, her ally gains <scaleHealth>@TotalBonusHealth@ bonus health</scaleHealth> and nearby enemies are <status>Slowed</status> by @SlowPercent@% for 1 second.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: If cast on an ally, grants them movement speed and ability power for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
On Ally Cast: Target ally gains @MSBoost*100@% Movement Speed and @APBoost@ Ability Power for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

On Enemy Cast: Polymorphs an enemy champion for @PolymorphDuration@ seconds, disabling their ability to attack or cast spells and Slows by 60.
